text: A server that stops kills the programs it started (run in src/server/compositor.rs calls children.kill_all on exit), so an agent inside a decade pane dies with it. To restart the server from inside a pane, run decade restart in its own session, as in setsid -f sh -c 'target/debug/decade restart' with output to a file. decade restart sends SIGTERM, waits for the save, then starts the new build. Viewers close when the server sends Close, by design. Tried 2026-11-10.
